item.stem:
The diagram shows Bina's quadrilateral $PQRS$ with right-angle marks at $P$, $Q$, and $R$, and with the remaining interior angle at $S$ labelled $x$.

Which claim about $x$ is correct?

options.A: $x$ must be $90^\circ$, because the four interior angles of a quadrilateral sum to $360^\circ$.
options.B: $x$ is only an interior-angle label, so the quadrilateral sum does not constrain it.
options.C: Drawing the four sides is what forces $x=90^\circ$, rather than the $360^\circ$ angle sum.
options.D: $x$ can be any size, because the diagram prints three right-angle marks.
